label: rem:lichnerowicz-wkb-corollary
title: Lichnerowicz identity reduces the $\Phi_q$-WKB conjecture
html:
Remark. Lichnerowicz identity reduces the \Phi_q-WKB conjecture

The categorical Lichnerowicz identity provides the gauge Hessian at the categorical-instanton saddle. This q-Laplacian \Delta_ abla^q equals \mathfrak{D}_ abla^2 on the parallel-Reeb background. The Pfaffian structure on chiral spinors converts - frac{1}{2}\log \det \Delta_ abla^q = -\log \det |\mathfrak{D}_ abla| = - frac{1}{2}\log \det \mathfrak{D}_ abla, recovering the WKB S_1 formula.
